articles.title: Army leadership pushes indigenous production amid supply chain disruptions
articles.summary: The Indian Army leadership has emphasized accelerating indigenous defence production capabilities, responding to global conflicts and trade blockades. This critical move aims to bolster India's self-reliance (Aatmanirbharta) in military equipment. It is vital for enhancing national security and strategic autonomy, ensuring our armed forces are robustly equipped to meet future challenges while significantly reducing external dependencies.

articles.title: The evolution of firepower warrants deep reflection
articles.summary: The early 20th-century development of the torpedo revolutionized naval warfare, providing an asymmetric advantage. This innovation empowered numerically or technologically inferior forces to effectively challenge and defeat superior adversaries. Torpedoes delivered a potent pulse of destructive power, fundamentally altering naval tactics and strategy by emphasizing stealth and precision. This technological leap profoundly reshaped military doctrines, highlighting the strategic impact of new weapon systems.

articles.title: self-improving-loop added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article discusses a novel "safety-first self-improvement loop" for AI agents, a significant advancement over current methods that merely log failures. The proposed system involves executing tasks, tracking performance, analyzing data, auto-applying improvements, and crucially, auto-rolling back upon regression. This robust approach ensures AI systems evolve reliably and securely, enhancing performance and mitigating risks through controlled, continuous learning cycles.

articles.title: fastapi-error-handler added to PyPI
articles.summary: This article emphasizes the crucial need for consistent, elegant error handling in FastAPI applications. It explains how default API responses, often 'ugly' or inconsistent (e.g., 'Not Found'), negatively affect user experience. The text proposes a streamlined, one-line setup solution to ensure uniform and user-friendly error messages, significantly enhancing web API robustness and professionalism.

articles.title: High-ranking Pak terrorist shot once again: Here's a list of India's 'most-wanted' targets hit by 'unkown gunmen'
articles.summary: A noticeable pattern has emerged in Pakistan and PoK where several high-profile terrorists, designated most-wanted by India, are being eliminated. These incidents, often mysterious, signify a crucial shift in regional security dynamics. This development directly impacts India's counter-terrorism strategy, highlighting ongoing efforts and potential changes in the operational landscape against groups hostile to Indian interests.
